label: models/fw_drum.mdl: a rusted 55-gallon drum with a hazard stripe

measured.lineup: the asset is one of A to D in lineup.png beside models/w_longjump.mdl, models/rip.mdl, models/uplant1.mdl
measured.lineupTest: asked 4 times, each in another order, which of the four was not made by Valve: judges picked C, D, B, D where the asset was D, A, C, C: passed for one of the game's

M1.reason: The outline reads as a 55-gallon drum in every view: a straight cylinder with slightly chamfered top and bottom edges, and two rolled rings (top and bottom) standing out at the same widths. Nothing sticks out or is missing.

M2.reason: Measured 25.2 across by 24.2 deep by 35 high against the brief's 23 across and 34 high: width is 9.6% over, depth 5.2% over, height 3% over. All three are within 15% of the brief's size.

M3.reason: Parts the brief implies, listed down to the small ones: body, top chime, bottom chime, a bung (fill plug) on the top rim (visible front, left, right and front-left views), a small lug on the bottom rim (BELOW view), and the hazard band. All are present and in place. The top and bottom are faceted at roughly 12 to 14 sides (TOP view), which is fine at game size for a round drum, so no charge here.

M4.reason: Blue painted steel body, brown rust on the two rings, and yellow and black hazard paint on the band. Each region reads as the material it should be, and no region is in the wrong colour or material.

M5.reason: The brief's 'rusted' is shown only on the two rings. The blue body in every view is clean: no rust streaks, dents, scrapes or stains, so the drum reads as freshly painted and not rusted. Hazard stripes are sharp and in the band's place, and the rings have grain. The body wear is missing (FRONT, BACK, and the body in all eight angled views).

M6.reason: Measured by the line-up test: four readings, each with the asset in a different place, and the judges picked a Valve original as the one not made by Valve in all four (C, D, B, D). The asset was never picked, so it passed as one of the game's. Capped at 2 for this item.

M7.reason: Upright, flat and closed at the bottom (BELOW view), and it stands on its base. The brief does not set a front for a drum; the bung on the top rim faces the front and sides as expected.

M8.reason: 272 triangles against the 422 Half-Life's most-spending prop of this kind and size uses, under the amended bar that fails only past that maximum (the 198 of twice the median would fail, but the 2026-10-16 amendment sets the bar). Nothing open: the top and bottom are capped, and nothing floats or is inside out. The checkErrors list is empty.
